guide.summary: A solid food that stays where you put it.
guide.biology: Starch is a large molecule that must be broken down before most cells can absorb it.
guide.rules: Adds a stationary starch deposit. Recycler eats it directly. Crumbsmith's enzyme turns it into sugar that anyone nearby can eat. No additional modeled reaction.
guide.example: Place starch beside Crumbsmiths and watch a sugar haze appear around it.
